_comment: Coverage ratchet baseline. See scripts/check-coverage-ratchet.mjs. Values are the FLOOR: CI fails if measured coverage drops below them. Raise them deliberately (pnpm coverage:ratchet --update) after a real improvement; never lower them to make a red build green.
_measured_2026-09-19: statements 6.06 / branches 4.66 / functions 4.69 / lines 6.60 (481 web-ui tests; whole packages/web-ui/src in the denominator, all:true)
_correction_2026-09-19: 早先记录的 29.92/24.97/24.13/31.48 是**分母错误**造成的假数字：那次跑 --project web-ui --coverage 时生效的是根级 include（统计了 292 个后端文件），再加上 all 语义不同，分母偏小 → 比例虚高。真实前端覆盖率见上。详见 audit-reports/test-hardening-2026-09-19.md §F1。
_note_key: 键名必须与 scripts/check-coverage-ratchet.mjs 读取的 'web-ui' 一致；写成 'packages/web-ui' 会导致 floor 取不到 → 棘轮静默失效。
